updates.title: CVE-2026-83711: Azure AD B2C Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
updates.summary: A critical authorization bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Azure Active Directory B2C allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges through user-controlled keys. Admins managing B2C tenants should apply security updates immediately to prevent unauthorized access to protected resources.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70352: Azure AI Language Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure AI Language enables unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations using Azure AI Language services should patch immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70178: Microsoft Fabric Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A missing authorization flaw in Microsoft Fabric allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges across the network. Admins should prioritize patching to prevent insider threats from exploiting privilege escalation.

updates.title: Enhanced sAMAccountName Synchronization for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Domain Services now supports synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) from on-premises via the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute, with the feature enabled by default for new managed domains. This improves hybrid identity consistency and reduces configuration complexity for organizations managing legacy applications requiring sAMAccountName values.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management Connector Moves to Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Microsoft Rights Management connector is transitioning from shared-secret to certificate-based authentication, enhancing security posture. Admins must configure custom Entra app registrations and certificates using new PowerShell cmdlets for each workload (Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI).

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online Classification Failures
updates.summary: Admins can now create fine-grained DLP policies for Exchange Online that respond to specific classification failures (timeout, throttling, scan errors) rather than applying one blanket policy. This public preview capability improves resilience by enabling targeted protection strategies based on failure type.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new device health dashboard for Endpoint DLP allows admins to monitor device status across their organization and identify systems not ready for policy updates. This visibility helps ensure smooth policy deployment and compliance enforcement across endpoints.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability and Policy Management Enhancements
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is expanding auto-labeling to handle larger SharePoint scopes with improved policy management and richer reporting visibility. These enhancements enable organizations to deploy classification at enterprise scale with better transparency into labeling activities.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer for macOS
updates.summary: The Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer applications are now available on macOS, bringing parity with Windows clients for most features. This enables consistent labeling and viewing capabilities across platforms, though advanced label-based protection remains unavailable on macOS.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-the-box dashboard tracks Mean Time to Acknowledge, Detect, and Resolve (MTTA/MTTD/MTTR) metrics for DLP alerts with customizable SLA thresholds. Admins can now measure operational performance and identify trending sensitive information types exposed through DLP alerts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Azure PST Import
updates.summary: Azure PST Import enables direct migration of PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern. This feature supports analysis validation before execution, reducing migration risk and simplifying data onboarding workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Auto-Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB Limit
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limitation, ensuring uninterrupted retention and scalable growth for organizations with high compliance and archival requirements. This enhancement is available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: The Information Protection Scanner now exports labeling, classification, and protection action data to SQL tables, enabling admins to build custom reports on scanned repository health. This capability provides deeper visibility into scanning operations and classification effectiveness.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Support for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention policies now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the standard classification engine. This expands DLP coverage beyond Microsoft 365 to hybrid cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Admins can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode before enforcement to preview which items would be labeled and review match results and source distribution. This safe-testing capability reduces risk of misconfigured policies impacting production data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Policy Insights Dashboard
updates.summary: A new Insights tab in auto-labeling policy details provides at-a-glance performance metrics, with mode-specific views for simulation and enforcement modes. This transparency helps admins optimize labeling policies before and after rollout.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Sensitivity label auto-labeling policies now extend to non-Microsoft connected applications including Box and Google Workspace, leveraging existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This enables consistent data classification across hybrid cloud storage environments.
